implementationDecisionsForSourceGaps: Because Module 17 defines POST /payments but no separate payment-post route, create payment posts it atomically instead of inventing a ninth endpoint.

Payment Finance posting follows the explicit requirement that cash payment reduces Supplier Payable and Cash/Bank; allocation does not post Finance again.
